body.en: Hugo: Hunt, Coord Attack and Extra Attack

Hugo's Gimmick is his Commence the Hunt
Commence the Hunt in gained mainly from Hunting Instinct
Hunting Instinct gains Commence the Hunt from Skill/Upgrade card use
FROM ALLIES, Unless you get Instinct 5 which adds his own cards too
Commence the Hunt is an Extra Attack
It triggers whenever anyone on your team uses a Single Target Attack Card
Commence the Hunt deals Additional damage based on the number of stacks
Try to keep yourself at 5 stacks of Hunt, and slowly chip at it for max damage
